EstimateGas is a method that takes a "EstimateGasRequest" body and returns an "EstimateGasResponse".
This method is used to estimate the recommended maximum gas for a signed binary transaction.

List is a method that takes a "TransactionRequest" body and returns an "TransactionList".
This method is used to retrieve a list of transactions based on the provided request parameters.

ParseTransaction is a method that takes a "ParseTransactionRequest" body and returns an "ParseTransactionResponse".
This method is used to parse a signed binary transaction and optionally verify its signature.

SubmitTransaction is a method that takes a "SubmitTransactionRequest" body and returns an "SubmitTransactionResponse".
This method is used to submit a signed binary transaction to the network.
